mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past two months indicates rising inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decreases do not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or HOUST increases do not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS levels above 4.5% do not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decreases do not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously over the past month, it signals a robust labor market, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive over the past quarter and housing starts (HOUST) increase over the past two months, it indicates a strong demand environment, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 0.5% in 1 quarter and HOUST increases > 5% in 2 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of GDPC1 and HOUST does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).
